{
  "found": true,
  "rule": {
    "trigger_kind": "incident",
    "event": "sfp_replaced",
    "symptoms": [
      "link_up",
      "counters_zero"
    ],
    "stated_condition": "old TX-200 units from 2016",
    "condition_is_relative": false,
    "action": "interface.bounce",
    "action_text": "disable the interface, wait about 30 seconds, and then enable it again",
    "avoid": [
      "node.reboot"
    ],
    "excerpt": "Try to disable the interface, wait about 30 seconds, and then enable it again. Don't reboot the node, the port bounce usually does the trick.",
    "said_by": "Erkki Expert",
    "said_by_role": "expert",
    "hedged": false,
    "first_hand": false,
    "outcome": "failed",
    "outcome_excerpt": "Tried the bounce, didn't help. Counters still stuck at zero after the disable/enable.",
    "about_entity": "TRN-019"
  },
  "reason": "The expert states a reusable rule for a bug on old TX-200 units from 2016 after SFP replacement where the link is up but counters stay at zero, recommending an interface bounce instead of a reboot, which subsequently failed to resolve the issue."
}
